name: business-mono
title: Business full-stack monorepo
description: A full-stack pnpm monorepo for business applications. Ships apps/api (Express + TypeScript + pg + redis), apps/web (lhx-kit MPA + React 19 with project.config, MSW mocks, stores), packages/types (shared TypeScript contracts), packages/utils (shared helpers). Biome + husky + commitlint + Turborepo.
